items.text: Conduct end-to-end (E2E) sanity and regression testing for Smart Home device.
Execute Android certification suites, including CTS, GTS, VTS, and STS.
Perform software verification for development programs.
Validate device-dependent functionalities and connectivity standards, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Internationalization (i18n).
Compile and present comprehensive test result summaries.
Manage the full defect lifecycle: issue reporting, tracking, and triage.
Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing on resolved issues.

Design, author, and maintain detailed test cases.
Organize and archive project-specific documentation for audit and reference.

description.text:
1. Test Execution & Verification
- Conduct end-to-end (E2E) sanity and regression testing for Smart Home device.
- Execute Android certification suites, including CTS, GTS, VTS, and STS.
- Perform software verification for development programs.
- Validate device-dependent functionalities and connectivity standards, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Internationalization (i18n).
2. Defect Management & Reporting
- Compile and present comprehensive test result summaries.
- Manage the full defect lifecycle: issue reporting, tracking, and triage.
- Verify bug fixes and perform regression testing on resolved issues.
3. Documentation & Strategy
- Develop and maintain test strategy documentation and project artifacts.
- Design, author, and maintain detailed test cases.
- Organize and archive project-specific documentation for audit and reference.

job.title: LS-美商科技大廠-Manual QA (歡迎軟韌體測試經驗，熟Linux/公司提供三餐、下午茶、福利完整)

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
- 1+ Year of QA testing experience in smart devices, smart phones or other electronic devices
- 50-100 manual tests per day in previous job
- Ability to create test plan/test case
- Ability to use ADB command for log capturing, familiar with Linux
- Well domain knowledge of smoking/sanity/regression tests - Familiar with reporting bugs (using bug tracking system like Jira/etc...)
- Familiar with Linux shell commands (at least need to be comfortable to run shell commands on Linux console according to the documentation).
